guardrails-poc.vision: Every AI agent that goes live is proven safe with the same yardstick.
guardrails-poc.value: The bank can show the regulator real safety evidence without buying an extra guardrail.
guardrails-poc.achieve: Ran 3,600 tests and advised not buying XecGuard yet; Vulcan is in progress.

agentic-platform-eval.vision: The bank knows which agent platform is safe to build on before it buys.
agentic-platform-eval.value: Avoids missing features midway or security holes after launch, with a side-by-side basis to choose.
agentic-platform-eval.achieve: Led the tests and found 12 issues before purchase, including 4 launch blockers and 1 security hole.

agent-cost-roi.vision: Four AI agents link the whole customer journey, from first contact to wealth management.
agent-cost-roi.value: Leaders decide who gets resources first from one table, then track if estimates come true.
agent-cost-roi.achieve: Four prototypes and a shared cost-benefit framework are done; each agent's baseline is in progress.

agent-loan-assistant.vision: Customers always get an answer on the application platform, so they no longer leave.
agent-loan-assistant.value: Its value is measured by extra applications won, not only by cost saved.
agent-loan-assistant.achieve: Prototype and measurement framework are done; the baseline awaits volume data from the business.

agent-credit-review.vision: Underwriters spend less time checking documents, so approvals are faster and more consistent.
agent-credit-review.value: Underwriters save checking time, and managers see cost per case and three-year budget use.
agent-credit-review.achieve: Prototype, unit cost and three-year cost baseline are done, and production resources are confirmed.

agent-customer-service.vision: Agents focus on customers while an AI sidekick looks things up and writes the notes.
agent-customer-service.value: Less lookup during calls and less note writing after, with peak capacity neither short nor wasted.
agent-customer-service.achieve: Prototype, cost framework and call baseline are done; resources await the vendor's estimate.

agent-wealth-assistant.vision: One question tells customers where their assets stand, leading naturally to advice.
agent-wealth-assistant.value: Customers skip digging through accounts, and the bank deepens its wealth management value.
agent-wealth-assistant.achieve: Built a working 118-page prototype with an AI wealth assistant myself; launch resources are confirmed.

agent-governance.vision: Every AI gets a clear compliance check before it goes live.
agent-governance.value: Regulator principles become a fill-in checklist; new projects only add their rules and test set.
agent-governance.achieve: Turned six principles into a nine-cell table and finished the framework; agent data is being gathered.

finllm.vision: A finance-only language model learns from correct, compliant data from the start.
finllm.value: Item-by-item cleaning and rule scoring lower the risk of the model learning errors or breaking rules.
finllm.achieve: Finished cleaning batch 2-1 and rule scoring for batch 4; batch 5 is in progress.

gemini-training.vision: Staff learn how AI fits their own work, and how to use it safely.
gemini-training.value: Class practice uses each unit's own work cases, not just a tour of tool features.
gemini-training.achieve: Led the planning and the outline is confirmed; case collection is in progress before the first class.

ai-ops-dashboard.vision: One dashboard answers leaders' top question: are these AI investments worth it?
ai-ops-dashboard.value: Internal tools and external agents share one metric set, so results and costs compare together.
ai-ops-dashboard.achieve: The five-part metric framework is designed; the dashboard is in planning and the first report awaits data.

a2ui-research.vision: AI replies with bank-approved charts and forms, not just text.
a2ui-research.value: Customers read money information more easily, while the bank still decides which screen parts are allowed.
a2ui-research.achieve: Three candidate use cases are mapped and PoC resources are being confirmed; next is the value checkpoint.

webai-finance.vision: Researchers spend their time on research, not on collecting and sorting data.
webai-finance.value: The whole group asks AI about markets and stocks in its usual screen, with fund data kept separate.
webai-finance.achieve: Took it alone from requirements to production launch as an intern; measuring the impact is next.

ai-governance-review.vision: Group AI governance reviews become faster and consistent, no longer read one by one by hand.
ai-governance-review.value: Reviewers get results already judged, recalculated and cross-checked, saving effort and aligning standards.
ai-governance-review.achieve: The system is live with automatic CI/CD deployment; the before-and-after review time is yet to be measured.

rag-support-bot.vision: Members find answers in the manuals with one question, without waiting for support.
rag-support-bot.value: Members get instant answers, and admins update the knowledge base with no engineer needed.
rag-support-bot.achieve: Changed how documents are split, raising accuracy from 60% to 85% with answers in about 2 to 3 seconds.

multi-agent-advisory.vision: AI splits work and debates like a fund team to reach investment calls that can be checked.
multi-agent-advisory.value: Avoids one model's blind spots, and every buy or sell signal comes with reasoning that can be checked.
multi-agent-advisory.achieve: Designed the roles and linked TEJ data; the five agents ran a three-year Taiwan stock backtest.

asr-transcription.vision: The research team gets earnings call key points without typing up each call by ear.
asr-transcription.value: Researchers can compare key points across companies and quarters directly.
asr-transcription.achieve: Videos now auto-convert to transcripts and summary tables, cutting prep time; the gain is yet to be measured.

financial-statement-vlm.vision: Scanned statements read as accurately as text files, figure by figure.
financial-statement-vlm.value: Reads table structure and figures together, not just image to text.
financial-statement-vlm.achieve: In production; accuracy and volume to be added.

moda-t-ambassador.vision: Rural groups and small firms can use generative AI too, narrowing the digital gap.
moda-t-ambassador.value: Firms without AI talent get help turning their real problems into digital solutions.
moda-t-ambassador.achieve: Completed the 6th cohort and helped firms adopt generative AI and AIoT; results to be added.

tmba-cta-taiex.vision: Build a trading strategy that can be reproduced, measured and tested.
tmba-cta-taiex.value: Return, Sharpe ratio and max drawdown together show the risk behind the return.
tmba-cta-taiex.achieve: The TAIEX futures CTA strategy I led won 3rd place at the 26th TMBA showcase.

tmba-event-earnings-call.vision: Test whether the moment a company explains its business and outlook can become a trade.
tmba-event-earnings-call.value: Backtesting return and risk on history gives the event-trading idea data behind it.
tmba-event-earnings-call.achieve: Led and backtested the earnings call strategy; the full research is written up in OpenStrategy.

thesis-rag-panel.vision: AI reads the text of financial reports to find signals that classic ratios miss.
thesis-rag-panel.value: A method for report analysis: build the AI system first, then prove it works with statistics.
thesis-rag-panel.achieve: Adding 6 LLM scores raised the model's explanatory power from 5.14% to 63.73%.

fubon-esg-portfolio.vision: Answer whether ESG really pays off in stock investing.
fubon-esg-portfolio.value: Hands-on experience of researcher and fund manager work, with feedback from fund managers.
fubon-esg-portfolio.achieve: Finished and presented the final project in NTUST's first cohort; portfolio results to be added.

thesis-esg-capital-structure.vision: Find out whether ESG risk scores affect how Taiwanese companies are financed.
thesis-esg-capital-structure.value: Links the ESG scores investors watch to how companies raise their funding.
thesis-esg-capital-structure.achieve: Finished the thesis and earned the degree; design and findings to be added.

tunghai-english-ta.vision: Students learn core business courses well in English.
tunghai-english-ta.value: Helps students learn statistics, economics and financial management in English.
tunghai-english-ta.achieve: Completed the TA role for three English-taught courses; duty details to be added.

finjourney.vision: Anyone can see their whole financial picture at a glance and spot what is wrong.
finjourney.value: Scattered money figures sit on one map, and AI adds a diagnosis and next steps.
finjourney.achieve: Built alone from first commit to launch in under two weeks, backed by 656 automated backend tests.

vibe-edge.vision: One person can do institution-grade quant research with results you can trust.
vibe-edge.value: AI brings the speed, while fixed statistical tests the agents cannot change guard the trust.
vibe-edge.achieve: Reached 0.6.0 in 12 weeks with the full flow running and 3,749 tests passing; no factor admitted yet.

fincli.vision: Quant research gets raw, traceable Taiwan stock data to work with.
fincli.value: Taiwan data with no ready-made package arrives automatically each day, with raw numbers intact.
fincli.achieve: 23 source modules update automatically after each close and feed Vibe-Edge's data layer.

openstrategy.vision: Find abnormal returns around earnings calls and turn them into a tradable signal.
openstrategy.value: An event study and regression found four explaining factors, giving stock picks a statistical basis.
openstrategy.achieve: Organized into 10-stage code; the 2025 Sharpe ratio of 0.94 slightly trailed the market's 0.99.
